actors.description: 28car API for public Hong Kong vehicle listings by keyword. Return 37 normalized fields for HKD prices, vehicle attributes, seller context, images, and source URLs with 28car-only routing

actors.name: amazon-reviews-scraper
actors.title: Amazon Reviews Scraper
actors.description: Scrape the Amazon reviews shown on product pages, across up to 21 marketplaces: rating, title, text, author, date, country, verified purchase, variant, helpful votes and images, deduplicated. Plus each product's star histogram and "Customers say" summary. Export to JSON/CSV

actors.name: shopify-store-scraper
actors.title: Shopify Scraper [] - store product catalogs
actors.description: Scrape shopify.com - every product with variants & SKUs · barcodes with inventory levels · integer-cent prices plus optional reviews & store contacts. Incremental mode tracks new and changed products across scheduled runs

actors.name: google-lens-reverse-image-search
actors.title: Google Lens Reverse Image Search - Visual Matches, No Login
actors.description: Google Lens reverse image search, per image: paste image links and get one row per visual match (page, title, site, the original picture and its size), plus the pages about the picture - or every page carrying that exact image. One flat row per result. No login, no API key, no start-up setup

actors.name: superbid-product-search-scraper
actors.title: Superbid Product Search Scraper
actors.description: Scrape product listings from SuperBid.net with comprehensive auction details. Collect 40+ fields including bids, pricing, seller info, and auction status from search results - perfect for market research, price analysis, and competitor monitoring

actors.name: vergelijk-product-search-scraper
actors.title: Vergelijk Product Search Scraper
actors.description: Scrape product listings from Vergelijk.be (varusok.se, sammenlign.dk, sammenlign.no, vergelijk.nl, comparer.be, comparer.fr, bestekauf.de) with complete pricing intelligence. Extract product summaries, shop offers, discounts, EANs, and SKUs from comparison pages

actors.name: autotrader-uk-scraper
actors.title: AutoTrader UK Scraper Cars, Vans, Bikes & Motorhomes
actors.description: Scrape AutoTrader UK cars, vans, bikes, motorhomes, caravans, trucks, farm and plant listings from any search link. Get price, mileage, specs, registration, description, equipment, vehicle check, price rating, working HD photos and seller phone, address and ratings

actors.name: airbnb-search-scraper
actors.title: Airbnb Search Scraper
actors.description: Scrapes Airbnb search results with full filter support: dates, guests, price, room type, property type, amenities, booking options, and category tags

actors.name: vinted-cross-country-price-gap
actors.title: Vinted Prices by Country - Cheapest vs Priciest Site
actors.description: Type a keyword and get its asking price on up to 8 Vinted country sites in USD. Returns each country's median from ~96 listings, the cheapest and priciest, the gap %, and a buy-here/sell-there margin before shipping and duty., charged only when two countries answer. Unofficial

actors.name: shopify-store-app-detector-theme-and-products
actors.title: Shopify Store App Detector: Apps, Theme & Products
actors.description: Find out which apps and theme any Shopify store uses, plus its product count, country and currency. Bulk store domains in, one row per store out. Reads public pages only. Built for app developers and agencies

actors.name: new-world-nz-scraper
actors.title: New World NZ Scraper - Store Prices, Clubcard, Specials, EAN
actors.description: New World NZ (newworld.co.nz) scraper: store, product ID, name, brand, size, shelf price, Clubcard price, unit price, promotions, category, channels, URL; details add EAN barcode, ingredients, allergens, nutrition, image. Keyword or category, one store to all. Pay per result, no login

actors.name: autoscout24-scraper
actors.title: AutoScout24 Scraper - European Car Listings
actors.description: Extract AutoScout24 car listings, prices, mileage and dealer data. Optional details, per-search limits, budget checks and explicit coverage reports. Export JSON/CSV for vehicle market research

actors.name: app-keyword-rank-tracker
actors.title: App Store & Google Play Keyword Rank Tracker (ASO)
actors.description: Track app keyword rankings on the App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android) in 174 countries and every store language: your apps' positions plus the top apps with rating and developer. Schedule it daily for ASO rank history. Export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or via API. No login

actors.name: vita-monitor
actors.title: Vita Pharmacy Price & Availability Monitor
actors.description: Track prices and stock across the Vita pharmacy chain (vitaexpress.ru) - price, availability, out-of-stock (дефектура) detection, and what changed since the last run

actors.name: olx-scraper
actors.title: OLX Brazil Scraper - Any Category, Any Keyword
actors.description: Searches any category on olx.com.br - real estate, cars, electronics, anything - and returns priced listings with structured attributes (area, bedrooms, mileage, color, engine) parsed from the site's own detail chips. No seller identity is ever collected

actors.name: olx-brazil-scraper
actors.title: OLX Brazil Listings Scraper
actors.description: Search OLX Brazil (olx.com.br) classifieds by keyword and collect structured listings -- titles, prices, locations, categories, and images -- across paginated results in one clean dataset per query, no manual city-by-city browsing

actors.name: olx-brasil
actors.title: OLX Brasil Scraper - Classified Listings
actors.description: Scrape OLX Brasil (olx.com.br) classified search results: title, price BRL, city, UF, neighborhood, category, detail URL and image. Clean BR schema - no phone harvesting. HTTP-only; default RESIDENTIAL + BR

actors.name: ifood-com-br-scraper
actors.title: iFood Scraper - Brazil Menu Prices & Restaurants
actors.description: Scrape ifood.com.br - menu items from restaurants and stores across Brazil. Each row carries the price and original price plus the description and image, with the restaurant name and rating, delivery time and fee. Incremental mode flags new and changed items between runs

actors.name: vtex-products-scraper
actors.title: VTEX Products Scraper - Public Catalog Export
actors.description: Export the catalogue of any VTEX store (Auchan, Chedraui and thousands of retailers in Europe and Latin America) from its public search endpoint: title, brand, EAN, prices, list prices, stock, categories, specifications and images, one row per product. No login, no proxies, no personal data
